caption: The drawing depicts a round, bronze or copper-colored metal object with intricate raised designs. The object consists of several concentric circular layers featuring scalloped and embossed patterns. At the center, there is a heart-shaped motif flanked by symmetrical, curved elements, and above the heart, an animal head appears to extend to the right, with visible eyes and nostrils. Additional decorative elements create a sense of symmetry and elaborate detail throughout the object. On the left side, a latch or hinge component is visible, and on the right, another hinge or clasp is present. The object appears three-dimensional, rendered with shading and tonal variations of brown, gold, and greenish patina, suggesting age. The background is plain and off-white, without any additional objects or decoration. The name "HARRY MANN WADDELL" is written in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Baptismal Font
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
